scientific_integrity: The mathematical argument is self-contained and distinguished from its finite-case verifier. The initiating paper supplies the general cycle-improvement framework and is credited; exact enumeration and concentration are the new claims.
scientific_limitations: Pure deterministic loopless bidirected complete bipartite networks; prior-free equilibrium only. Balanced-network asymptotic applies to uniform sampling from labeled equilibria, not outcomes of improvement dynamics. No independent external validation or exhaustive publication-priority assurance.
title: Exact prior-free buck-passing equilibrium spectrum and typical fairness on \(K_{a,b}\)
